{{Commodity infobox|painite}}

'''Painite''' is a rare mineral cargo commodity obtained primarily through asteroid mining. It can be sold through commodity markets or delivered to [[Selene Jean]] as part of her Engineer unlock.<ref name="inara-painite">[https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/84/ Painite — Commodity], INARA.</ref><ref name="selene" /> Painite occupies cargo space; it is not held in the separate [[Engineering Materials]] inventory.

== Acquisition ==

{{Commodity acquisition|painite}}

The established routes are '''laser mining in Metallic rings''' and '''core mining in Metal Rich rings'''.<ref name="wiki-painite" /> The available community sources disagree on whether Metallic rings also contain Painite cores, so that combination remains unconfirmed. No Painite-specific subsurface-deposit, uncracked surface-deposit, or planetary surface-mining route has been established.

A matching [[Mining Hotspot|hotspot]] narrows the search but does not replace checking the ring type and carrying equipment for the intended extraction method. See [[How to Laser Mine]] or [[How to Core Mine]] for complete fitting and extraction procedures.

=== Buying and salvage ===

INARA lists Painite as produced by mining rather than ordinary station economies. Player-operated [[Fleet Carrier|Fleet Carriers]] may offer mined stock for resale, but supply and access can change without notice; check the report age and actual quantity before travelling.<ref name="inara-painite" /> Community records also report Painite cargo as salvage at some signal sources, although mining is the predictable acquisition route.<ref name="wiki-painite" />

== Uses ==

{{Commodity uses|painite}}

[[Selene Jean]] requires 10 units of mined Painite after her invitation requirement has been met. The invitation milestone and the Painite donation are separate conditions; her article covers the complete discovery, meeting, and unlock requirements.<ref name="selene" />

Painite can otherwise be sold at commodity markets with demand. Prices and demand are dynamic, and stations with low demand may apply the mined-commodity bulk-sales adjustment, so check current market data before choosing a buyer.<ref name="inara-painite" />
